summary: Russia launched a massive overnight combined strike across Ukraine employing ballistic missiles and reactive Shahed drones, killing a mother and two children in Fastiv, Kyiv region, while Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets over at least eight oblasts. Kyiv region endured near-continuous air alerts for 24 hours with nine civilian objects damaged across four districts, including warehouses, production facilities, and an apartment building. President Zelensky unveiled a new interceptor drone system designed specifically to counter reactive Shahed UAVs. (Sources: @eRadarrua/114533, @UkraineNow/84181, @UkraineNow/84187)
key_points: Russian forces struck Fastiv, Kyiv region, killing a mother and two children on 19 September 2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/114533)

Overnight air alerts included missile threat (red level) and repeated drone threats (yellow level) over Kyiv, with reactive Shaheds targeting Kyiv, Irpin, Vyshhorod, Glevaха, Chabany, and TRC Lavina/Vynohradar. (Sources: @eRadarrua/114565, @eRadarrua/114574, @mon1tor_ua/75160, @mon1tor_ua/75182, @mon1tor_ua/75188, @kpszsu/79058, @kpszsu/79082, @kpszsu/79091)
Ballistic missile threat detected against Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia, with Iskander-M launch threat from Voronezh region. (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/75179, @mon1tor_ua/75197)

Reactive Shahed drones launched from multiple directions: Chernihiv region to Kyiv region, Bryansk region to Chernihiv region, Black Sea towards Tatarbunary, and across central Ukraine regions. (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/75181, @kpszsu/79084, @kpszsu/79055, @kpszsu/79060, @kpszsu/79064, @kpszsu/79076)
Ukrainian air defense engaged targets; Zelensky demonstrated new interceptor drone against reactive Shaheds. (Source: @UkraineNow/84187)
Russian Ministry of Defense claimed liberation of Zelena Dibrova, Maryevka, and Gulevo. (Source: @tass_agency/396229)

Nine civilian objects damaged in four Kyiv-region districts during near-continuous air alerts, including warehouses, production facilities, transport, and an apartment building. (Source: @UkraineNow/84181)
Russian official Rodion Miroshnik accused Ukraine of activating terrorist activity ahead of Russian elections. (Source: @tass_agency/396271)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight combined strike across Ukraine employing ballistic missiles and reactive Shahed drones, killing a mother and two children in Fastiv, Kyiv region, while Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets over at least eight oblasts. Kyiv region endured near-continuous air alerts for 24 hours with nine civilian objects damaged across four districts, including warehouses, production facilities, and an apartment building. President Zelensky unveiled a new interceptor drone system designed specifically to counter reactive Shahed UAVs.

points: Ukrainian air defenses actively engaged reactive Shahed drones over Kyiv, Irpin, Vyshhorod, and central Kyiv districts throughout the night, with monitoring channels reporting multiple intercepts near TRC Lavina/Vynohradar and Bucha. (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/75188, @kpszsu/79082, @kpszsu/79053)

President Zelensky publicly demonstrated a new interceptor drone system designed specifically to counter reactive Shahed-type UAVs, signaling accelerated development of dedicated counter-drone capabilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/84187)

Kyiv regional authorities confirmed nine civilian infrastructure objects damaged across four districts due to Russian attacks, including five warehouses, production and garage facilities, vehicles, and a residential apartment building, with air alerts persisting nearly continuously for 24 hours. (Source: @UkraineNow/84181)

Monitoring channels tracked reactive Shahed drones entering Ukrainian airspace from northern, eastern, and southern vectors, with specific sightings over Chernihiv, Poltava, Kirovohrad, and Mykolaiv regions, indicating broad front coverage. (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/75181, @kpszsu/79055, @kpszsu/79060, @kpszsu/79064, @kpszsu/79076)

Russian forces conducted a large-scale combined overnight strike employing both ballistic missiles (Iskander-M threat from Voronezh region) and reactive Shahed drones launched from multiple axes including Bryansk region, Chernihiv region, and the Black Sea. (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/75179, @mon1tor_ua/75197, @mon1tor_ua/75181, @kpszsu/79084)

A Russian strike on Fastiv, Kyiv region, on 19 September 2026 killed three civilians — a mother and two children — according to Ukrainian monitoring channels, highlighting continued targeting of populated areas. (Source: @eRadarrua/114533)

The Russian Ministry of Defense claimed its forces liberated the settlements of Zelena Dibrova, Maryevka, and Gulevo, though no specific front or date was provided in the statement. (Source: @tass_agency/396229)

Russian official Rodion Miroshnik alleged that Ukraine intensified "terrorist activity" ahead of Russia's State Duma elections, framing Ukrainian strikes as politically timed provocations. (Source: @tass_agency/396271)

Ballistic missile threat reported against Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia cities, with monitoring channels issuing specific alerts for Iskander-M launches from Voronezh region targeting the eastern industrial heartland. (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/75179, @mon1tor_ua/75197)

Reactive Shahed drones detected over Dnipropetrovsk and Kirovohrad regions, with groups tracked near Oleksandrivka past Dolynska and near Novyi Sanzhary, Poltava region, moving northwest. (Sources: @eRadarrua/114524, @kpszsu/79060)

Multiple reactive UAVs observed in Poltava region: near Novyi Sanzhary heading northwest, and towards Semenivka from the east, suggesting coordinated penetration of central-eastern airspace. (Sources: @kpszsu/79060, @kpszsu/79064)
Reactive UAV flew past Kropyvnytskyi towards Znamianka in Kirovohrad region, indicating continued pressure on central Ukrainian logistics and infrastructure. (Source: @kpszsu/79076)

Reactive Shahed drone launched from Bryansk region (Russia) entered Chernihiv region, Chernihiv district, while another from Chernihiv region crossed into Kyiv region, Vyshhorod district, demonstrating cross-border northern axis activity. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75181)

Reactive UAV transited through Chornobyl exclusion zone towards Zhytomyr region, and another approached Kyiv from north targeting Vyshhorod/Kyiv area, per monitoring reports. (Sources: @kpszsu/79055, @kpszsu/79053)

Kyiv region experienced near-continuous air alerts for 24 hours with missile (red) and drone (yellow) threats, including reactive Shaheds targeting Glevaха, Chabany, Bucha, and central Kyiv districts. (Sources: @eRadarrua/114565, @eRadarrua/114574, @kpszsu/79058, @kpszsu/79082, @kpszsu/79091)
Monitoring channel assessed ballistic threat to capital remains at medium-high level overnight, warning of potential massive combined strike. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75194)
Strike UAVs directed towards Tatarbunary from the Black Sea, indicating continued Russian use of naval launch platforms for southern Ukraine targets. (Source: @kpszsu/79084)
Reactive Shahed drone circling on the border of Mykolaiv and Odesa regions, with another reactive UAV on course to Voznesensk in Mykolaiv region. (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/75181, @kpszsu/79066)
Two reactive UAVs detected on Chernihiv region near Slavutych, moving southward, potentially linking northern and central axes. (Source: @eRadarrua/114554)

Kyiv experienced multiple air alert cycles: missile threat (red level) at 00:12, cancelled at 00:24; drone threat (yellow level) at 00:45, 02:14, with final cancellation at 03:06 on 20 September 2026. (Sources: @eRadarrua/114565, @eRadarrua/114569, @eRadarrua/114574, @eRadarrua/114596, @eRadarrua/114597, @eRadarrua/114599)
